news.n_isl_zab: They say that on the Great Zab river the Abbasid army under black banners has routed the last Umayyad caliph.
news.n_isl_talas: Merchants from the east say the Arabs have beaten a Chinese army by the Talas river, and among the captives are craftsmen who know how to make paper.
news.n_isl_mansur: News has come: the first Abbasid caliph, al-Saffah, has died, and his brother Abu Jafar al-Mansur has taken power.
news.n_isl_emirate: They say the last of the Umayyads, Abd al-Rahman, has fled across the sea to al-Andalus and made himself emir there.
news.n_isl_narbonne: Word from the west: the Franks of King Pepin have taken Narbonne, the last Muslim city beyond the mountains.
news.n_isl_baghdad: Caliph al-Mansur has chosen a site on the Tigris and is laying out a new capital — the City of Peace.
news.n_isl_ala: They say the emir of Córdoba has beaten the army sent against him from Baghdad and sent the caliph the heads of its commanders.
news.n_isl_jafar_sadiq: In Medina Jafar al-Sadiq has died, a scholar of the Prophet's family whom both Sunnis and Shiites studied under.
news.n_isl_abu_hanifa: In Baghdad the famous jurist Abu Hanifa has died in prison; he had refused to become a judge.
news.n_isl_charlemagne: Far to the west, Charles has become king of the Franks — a man, they say, of great height and great stubbornness.
news.n_isl_saxons: Merchants from Frankish lands say King Charles is at war with the pagan Saxons and is cutting down their sacred trees.
news.n_isl_mahdi: Caliph al-Mansur has died on the road to Mecca. His son al-Mahdi is now caliph.
news.n_isl_roncesvalles: They say the Frankish king Charles has left Zaragoza empty-handed, and in the Basque mountains his rearguard was destroyed.
news.n_isl_harun_bosphorus: News has come: young Harun, the caliph's son, has marched all the way to the Bosphorus, and the Byzantine empress has agreed to pay tribute.
news.n_isl_mezquita: They say the emir in Córdoba has begun building a huge mosque with two tiers of arches.
news.n_isl_harun: Harun al-Rashid has become the new caliph. They say a son was born to him that very night.
news.n_isl_idris: Word from the west: a descendant of Ali named Idris has fled to the far Maghreb, and the Berbers have recognised him as their imam.
news.n_isl_vikings: Sailors tell of northern raiders who, in long boats, attacked a monastery on an island off the land of the Angles.
news.n_isl_paper_mill: They say a workshop has been built in Baghdad that makes paper as in Samarkand. The scribes rejoice: papyrus and parchment are dear.
news.n_isl_irene: Word from Constantinople: the Empress Irene has blinded her own son and rules alone.
news.n_isl_emperor: They say that in Rome the Pope has crowned Charles, king of the Franks, emperor.
news.n_isl_elephant: They say the caliph has sent the Frankish emperor gifts: an elephant called Abu'l-Abbas, a water clock and a chess set.
news.n_isl_barmakids: News from Baghdad: the Barmakids have fallen from favour, and the vizier Jafar has been executed.
news.n_isl_heraclea: They say Caliph Harun himself led a huge army against Byzantium and took the fortress of Heraclea.
news.n_isl_harun_dies: News has come: Caliph Harun al-Rashid has died at Tus in Khurasan. His sons are dividing the inheritance.
news.n_isl_mamun: They say Baghdad has fallen after a long siege, Caliph al-Amin is dead, and his brother al-Ma'mun is caliph.
news.n_isl_rida: Astonishing news: Caliph al-Ma'mun has named Ali al-Rida of the Prophet's family as his heir and changed the Abbasid black to green.
news.n_isl_algebra: Scholars praise al-Khwarizmi's new book on reckoning, "al-jabr": with it you can divide inheritances and measure land.
news.n_isl_ziryab: They say the famous Baghdad singer Ziryab has gone to Córdoba and is teaching the Andalusis to eat courses in order and dress by the season.
news.n_isl_sicily: Word from the sea: an Aghlabid army from Ifriqiya has landed on Sicily.
news.n_isl_shammasiyya: They say an observatory has been built in Baghdad by the caliph's order, and astronomers are checking Ptolemy's ancient tables.
news.n_isl_mamun_dies: News has come: Caliph al-Ma'mun has died on campaign near Tarsus. His brother al-Mu'tasim is now caliph.
news.n_isl_amorium: They say Caliph al-Mu'tasim has taken and destroyed Amorium, the Byzantine emperor's home city.
news.n_isl_afshin: The famous general al-Afshin has died in prison: he was accused of secret loyalty to the old gods.
news.n_isl_seville_vikings: They say the northern heathens came up the river to Seville in ships and plundered it.
news.n_isl_rome_raid: Sailors say an Arab fleet sailed up the Tiber and plundered churches outside the walls of Rome.
news.n_isl_mihna_end: They say the new caliph al-Mutawakkil has stopped the interrogations about the created Qur'an.
news.n_isl_dhimmi_decree: Caliph al-Mutawakkil has ordered Christians and Jews to wear honey-coloured garments and build no new places of worship.
news.n_isl_malwiya: Travellers from Samarra tell of a minaret twisted into a spiral — you can ride up it on horseback.
news.n_isl_qarawiyyin: They say that in Fez in the West a pious woman, Fatima al-Fihri, has built the al-Qarawiyyin mosque with her inheritance.
news.n_isl_mutawakkil: Terrible news from Samarra: Turkish guardsmen have murdered Caliph al-Mutawakkil at a banquet.
news.n_isl_rus: Merchants from the north tell of a people called the Rus who trade furs and slaves on the Volga; they say they now have princes of their own.
news.n_isl_tulun: They say the Turk Ahmad ibn Tulun, sent to govern Egypt, has stopped obeying Samarra.
news.n_isl_bukhari: Al-Bukhari, the collector of hadith, has died. They say out of six hundred thousand reports he chose only a few thousand reliable ones.
news.n_isl_basra: Terrible news from the south: the Zanj have taken and burned Basra.
news.n_isl_ibn_tulun_mosque: In Egypt Ibn Tulun is building a huge mosque with a minaret wrapped by an outside staircase.
news.n_isl_syracuse: Word from the sea: after a long siege the Aghlabids have taken Syracuse.
news.n_isl_zanj_end: They say the Zanj revolt has been crushed, its leader killed, and his head paraded through the cities.
news.n_isl_court_returns: Caliph al-Mu'tadid has moved the court back from Samarra to Baghdad.
news.n_isl_qarmatians: From the Gulf coast come rumours of the Qarmatians — sectarians who reject the caliph's authority and plunder caravans.
news.n_isl_tulunids_end: The caliph's army has recovered Egypt: the last Tulunids have been carried off to Baghdad.
news.n_isl_fatimids: Word from the west: in Ifriqiya a mahdi named Ubaydallah has appeared and proclaimed himself caliph of the line of Fatima.
news.n_isl_abd_rahman_3: In Córdoba young Abd al-Rahman, grandson of the previous emir, has become emir.
news.n_isl_ibn_fadlan: They say the caliph's envoy Ibn Fadlan has returned from the Volga Bulghars and tells of snows, northern lights and a Rus funeral in a ship.
news.n_isl_razi: Al-Razi, the physician from Rayy who told smallpox from measles and boldly argued with Galen, has died.
news.n_isl_caliph_cordoba: They say the emir of Córdoba has declared himself caliph. Now there are three caliphs in the world.
news.n_isl_black_stone: Terrible news: the Qarmatians burst into Mecca during the Hajj, slaughtered pilgrims and carried off the Black Stone.
news.n_isl_zahra: They say the caliph of Córdoba is building a palace-city named after his beloved — al-Zahra.
news.n_isl_buyids: News has come: the Daylamite Buyids have occupied Baghdad, and the caliph has submitted to them.
news.n_isl_stone_back: The Qarmatians have returned the Black Stone to Mecca. Pilgrims weep with joy.
news.n_isl_lechfeld: They say Otto, king of the Germans, has defeated the Magyars, who had plundered his lands for decades.
news.n_isl_song: Merchants from China say a new dynasty, the Song, has come to power there.
news.n_isl_hakam_library: In Córdoba al-Hakam has become caliph — they say he buys books from all over the world.
news.n_isl_khazars: Word from the north: Sviatoslav, prince of the Rus, has crushed the Khazars and destroyed their city on the Volga.
news.n_isl_fatimid_egypt: They say the Fatimid army has entered Egypt without a fight and is building a new city beside Fustat.
news.n_isl_azhar: The al-Azhar mosque has opened in the new city of Cairo. They say jurists will be taught there.
news.n_isl_antioch_byz: They say the Byzantine emperor John Tzimiskes has marched through Syria almost to Jerusalem.
news.n_isl_almanzor: In Córdoba the chamberlain Ibn Abi Amir has seized all power; soon he will be called al-Mansur, "the Victorious".
news.n_isl_rus_baptism: Merchants from the north say Vladimir, prince of the Rus, has adopted the faith of the Greeks. They say he rejected Islam because of its ban on wine.
news.n_isl_santiago: They say al-Mansur of Córdoba has sacked Santiago, the Christians' shrine in the north, and made captives carry its bells to Córdoba.
news.n_isl_mahmud: Word from the east: Sultan Mahmud rules in Ghazni; he campaigns in India and brings back mountains of gold.
news.n_isl_almanzor_dies: News has come: al-Mansur of Córdoba has died after yet another campaign in the north.
news.n_isl_sepulchre: They say the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem has been destroyed on the orders of Caliph al-Hakim.
news.n_isl_shahnameh: They say the Persian poet Ferdowsi has finished a huge "Book of Kings" about the ancient shahs of Iran.
news.n_isl_cordoba_sacked: Terrible news from the west: Berber troops have taken and plundered Córdoba.
news.n_isl_druze: In Cairo preachers have appeared proclaiming Caliph al-Hakim an incarnation of the Divine; crowds chase them through the streets.
news.n_isl_hakim_gone: Caliph al-Hakim rode out at night into the Muqattam hills and never came back. Only his donkey and his clothes were found.
news.n_isl_canon: Physicians pass round Ibn Sina's "Canon of Medicine" — they say everything is in it.
news.n_isl_taifa: Word from the west: the caliphate has been abolished in Córdoba, and al-Andalus has broken into dozens of petty kingdoms.
news.n_isl_ibn_sina: News has come: Ibn Sina, the great physician and philosopher, has died in Hamadan.
news.n_isl_dandanqan: They say the Seljuk Turks have defeated the Ghaznavid sultan's army in the desert at Dandanaqan.
news.n_isl_biruni: Al-Biruni has died, the scholar who measured the Earth and wrote a book about India.
news.n_isl_schism: Christians say their patriarch and the Pope of Rome have excommunicated each other.
news.n_isl_tughril: They say the Seljuk Tughril Beg has entered Baghdad, and the caliph has named him sultan.
news.n_isl_normans_sicily: Word from the sea: Normans from the north have landed on Sicily and are fighting the island's Muslims.
news.n_isl_granada: They say that in Granada a mob has killed the Jewish vizier Joseph ibn Naghrela and many of the city's Jews.
news.n_isl_fatimid_treasury: Word from Egypt is that hungry troops have looted the treasury of the Cairo caliphs, and the library is being sold in the bazaar.
news.n_isl_manzikert: Great news: Sultan Alp Arslan has defeated the Byzantines at Manzikert and captured the emperor himself.
news.n_isl_palermo: Word from the sea: the Normans have taken Palermo.
news.n_isl_badr: They say the Armenian Badr al-Jamali has restored order in Egypt with an iron hand and become vizier.
news.n_isl_toledo: News has come: the Castilian king has taken Toledo.
news.n_isl_zallaqa: They say the Almoravids from across the sea have beaten the Castilians at al-Zallaqa.
news.n_isl_nizam: Terrible news: the vizier Nizam al-Mulk has been killed by an Ismaili assassin, and soon after Sultan Malik-Shah died too.
news.n_isl_cid: Word from the west: a Castilian knight called the Cid has taken Valencia.
news.n_isl_clermont: Merchants from Italy say the Pope of Rome has called on the Franks to march east to war.
news.n_isl_antioch: They say the Franks have taken Antioch after a long siege.
news.n_isl_jerusalem: Terrible news: the Franks have taken Jerusalem.
news.n_isl_acre: The Franks have taken Acre, and now their ships lie in the best harbour of the coast.
news.n_isl_tripoli: News has come: after a siege of years the Franks have taken Tripoli with its famous library.
news.n_isl_ghazali: Al-Ghazali has died, the theologian who left his chair in Baghdad and wandered for years as a Sufi.
news.n_isl_zaragoza: Word from the west: the king of Aragon has taken Zaragoza.
news.n_isl_tyre: They say the Franks, with the help of a Venetian fleet, have taken Tyre.
news.n_isl_zengi: The atabeg Imad al-Din Zengi rules in Mosul — they say he means to fight the Franks in earnest.
news.n_isl_khayyam: They say Omar Khayyam has died in Nishapur — an astronomer who reformed the calendar and, people whisper, an author of daring quatrains.
news.n_isl_edessa: Great news: Zengi has taken Edessa, the first Frankish county in the East.
news.n_isl_lisbon: Word from the west: the Portuguese king, with Frankish sailors, has taken Lisbon.
news.n_isl_damascus_siege: They say the Frankish kings came before Damascus but withdrew after four days.
news.n_isl_almohads: The Almohads have established themselves in al-Andalus. They say Jews and Christians there are being told to choose between Islam and exile.
news.n_isl_idrisi: They say the scholar al-Idrisi has made a silver map of the whole world for the Norman king of Sicily.
news.n_isl_amalric: They say King Amalric of Jerusalem is campaigning against Egypt, while the viziers in Cairo call on the Franks one day and Nur al-Din the next.
news.n_isl_saladin_vizier: News has come: the Kurd Salah al-Din, nephew of the general Shirkuh, has become vizier of Egypt.
news.n_isl_fatimids_end: They say the Fatimid caliph is no longer named in Cairo: Saladin has returned Egypt to the Baghdad caliph.
news.n_isl_saladin_damascus: Nur al-Din has died, and Saladin has taken Damascus.
news.n_isl_myriokephalon: They say the Seljuks of Rum have defeated the Byzantine emperor in a mountain pass at Myriokephalon.
news.n_isl_nasir: Al-Nasir has become caliph in Baghdad. They say he wants to give the caliphs real power again.
news.n_isl_hattin: Great news: Saladin has defeated the Franks at Hattin and recovered Jerusalem.
news.n_isl_acre_lost: The Frankish king Richard has taken Acre after a two-year siege. They say the prisoners were executed beneath the walls.
news.n_isl_saladin_dies: News has come: Saladin has died in Damascus. They say his treasury did not hold enough even for his funeral.
news.n_isl_alarcos: They say the Almohad caliph has defeated the Castilians at Alarcos.
news.n_isl_averroes: Ibn Rushd of Córdoba, the commentator on Aristotle, has died in Marrakesh.
news.n_isl_nile_famine: Word from Egypt tells of a terrible famine: the Nile has failed to flood two years running.
news.n_isl_constantinople_sacked: Unheard-of news: Franks who set out to attack Egypt have sacked Christian Constantinople. And in Fustat the physician and sage Maimonides has died.
news.n_isl_genghis: Merchants from the steppe tell of a Mongol chief proclaimed Genghis Khan, ruler of all the tribes.
news.n_isl_navas: Bitter news from the west: the Christian kings have defeated the Almohads at Las Navas de Tolosa.
news.n_isl_damietta: The Franks have landed at Damietta, at the mouth of the Nile.
news.n_isl_khwarazm: People are fleeing from the east: the Mongols have destroyed Bukhara, Samarkand and Urgench. They say nothing is left of the cities but ash and skulls.
news.n_isl_damietta_back: The Franks have given up Damietta: the Nile flooded and cut off their army.
news.n_isl_genghis_dies: They say Genghis Khan has died. But his sons carry on the wars.
news.n_isl_frederick: Astonishing news: Sultan al-Kamil has handed Jerusalem to the German emperor Frederick by treaty, without a war.
news.n_isl_cordoba_falls: Bitter news: Córdoba has surrendered to the king of Castile.
news.n_isl_granada_nasrids: They say Muhammad ibn al-Ahmar has established himself in Granada — the last Muslim emir on the peninsula.
news.n_isl_kyiv: Word from the north: the Mongols have taken Kyiv, the great city of the Rus.
news.n_isl_jerusalem_retaken: They say Khwarazmian horsemen fleeing the Mongols have taken Jerusalem from the Franks.
news.n_isl_seville: News has come: the Castilians have taken Seville.
news.n_isl_louis: They say the Mamluks have captured the French king and then killed their own sultan.
news.n_isl_baghdad_falls: The most terrible news: Hulagu's Mongols have taken Baghdad and executed the caliph.
news.n_isl_ain_jalut: Great news: the Mamluks have defeated the Mongols at Ain Jalut.
news.n_isl_cairo_caliph: Sultan Baybars has received a kinsman of the Abbasids in Cairo and proclaimed him caliph.
news.n_isl_antioch_baybars: They say Baybars has taken and destroyed Antioch.
news.n_isl_polo: Venetian merchants, they say, have set out through Persia to the Great Khan in China.
news.n_isl_rumi: Jalal al-Din Rumi has died in Konya. His disciples whirl in dance to the sound of the reed flute.
news.n_isl_baybars_dies: News has come: Sultan Baybars has died in Damascus.
news.n_isl_homs: They say Sultan Qalawun has beaten the Mongols again near Homs.
news.n_isl_acre_falls: Great news: the Mamluks have taken Acre. There are no more Franks on the coast.
news.n_isl_ghazan: Word from the east: the Mongol Ilkhan Ghazan has embraced Islam.
news.n_isl_osman: In Anatolia, they say, a bey named Osman is gaining strength; his warriors press the Byzantines.
news.n_isl_marj_saffar: They say the Mamluks have defeated Ghazan's Mongols at Marj al-Saffar near Damascus.
news.n_isl_nasir_muhammad: In Cairo al-Nasir Muhammad rules again, having taken the throne for the third time in his life.
news.n_isl_mansa_musa: Musa, king of Mali, has passed through Cairo to Mecca with a caravan of gold. They say he gave away so much that gold stayed cheap for years.
news.n_isl_ibn_battuta: A young jurist from Tangier, Ibn Battuta, has set out on the Hajj. No one yet knows he will travel half the world.
news.n_isl_bursa: They say the Ottomans have taken Bursa and made it their capital.
news.n_isl_ibn_taymiyya: The theologian Ibn Taymiyya has died in prison in the citadel of Damascus. The whole city came to his funeral.
news.n_isl_ilkhans_end: The Ilkhan Abu Said has died, and the Mongol kingdom in Persia is falling apart.
news.n_isl_salado: Word from the west: the Christians have defeated the Moroccans and Granadans on the Salado river.
news.n_isl_plague_alex: Word from Alexandria: a plague has arrived with a ship, and people are dying by the hundreds.
news.n_isl_gallipoli: They say the Ottomans have crossed the strait and occupied Gallipoli after an earthquake.
news.n_isl_sultan_hasan: In Cairo, beneath the citadel, Sultan Hasan has begun building a huge mosque and madrasa.
news.n_isl_alexandria_sack: Terrible news: the king of Cyprus and the Franks have suddenly attacked Alexandria and plundered it.
news.n_isl_ming: Word from China: the Mongols have been driven out, and there is a new dynasty — the Ming.
news.n_isl_timur_rise: They say a lame emir, Timur, has risen to power in Samarkand.
news.n_isl_muqaddimah: They say the scholar Ibn Khaldun has written a book about why kingdoms rise and fall.
news.n_isl_barquq: In Cairo the Circassian Barquq has become sultan — and with him the Circassian Mamluks have come to power.
news.n_isl_kosovo: Word from the Balkans: the Ottomans have defeated the Serbs on the Field of Kosovo, and Sultan Murad has been killed.
news.n_isl_nicopolis: They say Sultan Bayezid has crushed a huge army of Frankish knights at Nicopolis.
news.n_isl_aleppo_timur: News has come: Timur has taken Aleppo and is marching on Damascus.
news.n_isl_baghdad_timur: They say Timur has taken Baghdad and built towers out of the townspeople's heads.
news.n_isl_ankara: Incredible news: Timur has defeated the Ottomans at Ankara and captured Sultan Bayezid.
news.n_isl_timur_dies: News has come: Timur has died on his campaign against China.
news.n_isl_ibn_khaldun: Ibn Khaldun, historian and qadi, has died in Cairo.
news.n_isl_ceuta: Word from the west: the Portuguese have crossed the strait and taken Ceuta.
news.n_isl_murad_siege: They say Sultan Murad has besieged Constantinople but withdrawn.
news.n_isl_cyprus: The Mamluks have defeated the king of Cyprus and brought him to Cairo as a prisoner.
news.n_isl_thessalonica: They say the Ottomans have taken Thessalonica from the Venetians.
news.n_isl_varna: Word from the Balkans: Sultan Murad has defeated the Crusaders at Varna, and the Hungarian king has been killed.
news.n_isl_ulugh_beg: They say Ulugh Beg, the astronomer-ruler who built the great observatory, has been murdered in Samarkand.
news.n_isl_mehmed: Young Mehmed has become Ottoman sultan again. They say he dreams of Constantinople.
news.n_isl_constantinople: Great news: Sultan Mehmed has taken Constantinople. Hagia Sophia has become a mosque.
news.n_isl_belgrade: They say the Ottomans have fallen back from Belgrade, and the sultan is wounded.
news.n_isl_trebizond: Sultan Mehmed has taken Trebizond, the last Greek city on the Black Sea.
news.n_isl_fatih: In Istanbul Sultan Mehmed's great mosque has been founded on the site of the Church of the Holy Apostles.
news.n_isl_qaitbay: In Cairo Qaitbay has become sultan — a former mamluk once bought for fifty dinars.
news.n_isl_otlukbeli: They say the Ottoman cannon have routed the army of the Turkmen ruler Uzun Hasan.
news.n_isl_caffa: The Ottomans have taken Genoese Caffa in the Crimea, and the Crimean khan has acknowledged the sultan as his master.
news.n_isl_qaitbay_fort: In Alexandria Sultan Qaitbay is building a fortress on the site of the old lighthouse.
news.n_isl_otranto: They say the Ottomans have landed in Italy and taken Otranto.
news.n_isl_mehmed_dies: News has come: Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror has died. His sons are disputing the throne.
news.n_isl_cape: Sailors say the Portuguese have rounded the southern tip of Africa.
news.n_isl_granada_falls: Bitter news: Granada has surrendered to the Spanish monarchs. And Jews are being expelled from Spain — Sultan Bayezid is taking them into his lands.
news.n_isl_gama: They say Portuguese ships have sailed round Africa and reached India, at Calicut. The merchants of Cairo and Venice are alarmed.
news.n_isl_safavids: Word from the east: young Ismail has proclaimed himself shah in Tabriz and ordered everyone to become Shiite.
news.n_isl_castile_moors: They say the Muslims of Castile have been ordered to be baptised or leave.
news.n_isl_diu: News has come: the Portuguese have destroyed the Egyptian fleet at Diu in India.
news.n_isl_mecca_coffee: They say the muhtasib of Mecca has banned coffee and ordered sacks of beans burned, but the sultan in Cairo overturned the ban.
news.n_isl_selim: Selim, who deposed his own father, has become Ottoman sultan. They call him Yavuz — the Grim.
news.n_isl_chaldiran: They say Sultan Selim has defeated Shah Ismail at Chaldiran, and the Janissaries' cannon decided the battle.
news.n_isl_marj_dabiq: News has come: the Ottomans have defeated the Mamluks at Marj Dabiq, and Sultan al-Ghawri has fallen.
news.n_isl_cairo_falls: They say Sultan Selim has taken Cairo. Egypt is now Ottoman.
news.n_isl_suleiman: Sultan Selim has died. His son Süleyman has taken the throne.
news.n_isl_belgrade_taken: News has come: Sultan Süleyman has taken Belgrade.
news.n_isl_rhodes: They say the Knights Hospitaller have surrendered Rhodes to the sultan and sailed away west.
news.n_isl_mohacs: Great news: the Hungarian army has been destroyed at Mohács, and the king drowned in a marsh.
news.n_isl_vienna: They say the sultan's army besieged Vienna but withdrew because of the rains and cold.
news.n_isl_barbarossa: The corsair Hayreddin Barbarossa has become the sultan's admiral. Now the Ottoman fleet rules the sea.
news.n_isl_baghdad_ottoman: News has come: Sultan Süleyman has taken Baghdad from the Persians.
news.n_isl_preveza: They say Barbarossa has defeated the Christian fleet at Preveza.
news.n_isl_buda: The Ottomans have occupied Buda; most of Hungary is now under the sultan.
news.n_isl_nice: Astonishing news: the Ottoman fleet, together with the French, has besieged Nice, and wintered in French Toulon.
news.n_isl_tripoli_libya: They say the Ottoman fleet has taken Tripoli in Africa from the Knights Hospitaller.
news.n_isl_mustafa: Terrible news: on the sultan's orders his eldest son, Prince Mustafa, has been strangled in a tent. The Janissaries are grumbling.
news.n_isl_amasya: The sultan has made peace with the Persian shah at Amasya.
news.n_isl_hurrem: Hürrem has died, Sultan Süleyman's beloved wife — a former slave from the lands of the Rus.
news.n_isl_malta: They say the sultan's fleet failed to take Malta and returned empty-handed.
news.n_isl_suleiman_dies: News has come: Sultan Süleyman has died in Hungary, before Szigetvár.
news.n_isl_don_volga: They say the grand vizier wanted to dig a canal between the Don and the Volga, but the work was abandoned.
news.n_isl_cyprus_lepanto: The Ottomans have taken Cyprus, but at Lepanto the Christian fleet burned the Ottoman galleys.
news.n_isl_tunis: News has come: the Ottomans have taken Tunis from the Spaniards.
news.n_isl_comet: A huge comet has appeared over the city. Everyone reads it their own way.
news.n_isl_three_kings: Word from the west: three kings have died at Ksar el-Kebir in Morocco, the Portuguese one among them.
news.n_isl_observatory: They say the observatory in Istanbul has been torn down by the sultan's order.
news.n_isl_debasement: The coinage is debased: there is less and less silver in the akçe, and bazaar prices are rising. The Janissaries are unhappy with their pay.
news.n_isl_sinan: The architect Sinan has died, having lived, they say, almost a hundred years. His mosques stand throughout the empire.
news.n_isl_safavid_peace: Shah Abbas has made peace with the sultan and given up Tabriz.
news.n_isl_long_war: War with the Austrians in Hungary again. It looks like it will be a long one.
news.n_isl_mehmed_3: On the day of his accession the new sultan Mehmed ordered nineteen of his brothers executed. The city is horrified.
news.n_isl_kerestes: They say the sultan himself led the army into Hungary and won at Keresztes.
news.n_isl_east_india: Merchants say the English and Dutch are founding trading companies to bring spices from India by-passing Egypt.
news.n_isl_celali: In Anatolia the Celali rebels — runaway soldiers and ruined peasants — are rising. Villages are emptying.
news.n_isl_zsitvatorok: Peace has been made with the Austrians. For the first time the sultan has recognised their emperor as his equal.
news.n_isl_moriscos: They say the Spanish king is expelling the Moriscos — descendants of the Muslims of al-Andalus. Thousands are arriving in the Maghreb.
news.n_isl_blue_mosque: In Istanbul the mosque of Sultan Ahmed, with its six minarets, has been completed.
news.n_isl_osman_2: Terrible news: the Janissaries have deposed and killed the young sultan Osman.
news.n_isl_baghdad_safavid: The Persian shah Abbas has taken Baghdad.
news.n_isl_coffee_ban: After a great fire Sultan Murad has banned coffeehouses and tobacco. They say he walks the streets at night in disguise to catch offenders.
news.n_isl_crete: War with the Venetians over Crete has begun.
